description: This file defines the YAxisData class, which manages mapping of Y values (possibly sensor readings or data points) to associated data (ValuesHolder instances). It includes functionality for storing, retrieving, and logging updates to Y data points, as well as exporting data to a writer.

classes.name: YAxisData
classes.description: Manages Y-axis data points associated with a fixed X coordinate, allowing retrieval, update, and export of Y-value data.

classes.name: ValuesHolder
classes.description: Inner static class that holds accumulated data (total, count) for calculating averages of values associated with a specific Y coordinate.

methods.name: YAxisData
methods.description: Constructor initializing YAxisData with a fixed X coordinate.

methods.name: getX
methods.description: Returns the fixed X coordinate associated with this YAxisData instance.

methods.name: getYs
methods.description: Provides the set of Y values currently stored.

methods.name: findZ
methods.description: Finds the Z value corresponding to a Y value by floor or ceiling entry.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a specific Y point's associated value.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value to a Y point, updating its average and logging if necessary.

methods.name: getHolder
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ValuesHolder for a Y value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value for a given Y.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the YAxisData object.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Exports the data points to a Writer object in CSV format.
